CLARITY BEFORE COMMITMENT

Good questions.
Clear expectations.

The free first conversation is about understanding your needs. Scope, costs and arrangements are discussed before a project starts.

Do I need to know anything about AI?

No. Tell us how you work and what takes too much time. We can assess whether improving existing software, building a business system or using AI makes sense.

Can we keep the software we already use?

We first look at what your tools can already do, which connections they support and any extra costs. Recommendations follow that assessment.

What about our data and AI mistakes?

The proposed setup needs to identify which systems process your information, who can access it and which outputs need staff review. Please keep sensitive client information out of the initial enquiry until these arrangements are agreed.

What will it cost, and what happens afterwards?

Work is quoted to scope, with applicable software subscriptions or usage charges explained. Training, handover, maintenance and response arrangements are agreed in advance. The initial consultation is free; implementation is separately quoted.
